mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in GDP indicates strong economic demand, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: 20-day returns are negative when GDP growth is positive.

mechanism_narrative: A significant drop in unemployment signals a strong labor market, boosting S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: Returns are negative when unemployment is below 4%.

mechanism_narrative: Rising industrial production alongside increased real sales signals strong supply and demand, leading to positive returns.
failure_condition: Returns are negative when both indicators rise.

mechanism_narrative: During monetary tightening, higher FEDFUNDS negatively impact S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: Returns are positive when FEDFUNDS exceeds 4%.

mechanism_narrative: Consistently high payroll employment suggests economic strength, leading to positive S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: Returns are negative with high payroll employment.

mechanism_narrative: A surge in housing starts indicates strong demand, leading to positive S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: Returns are negative when housing starts exceed 1300.

mechanism_narrative: Rising FEDFUNDS alongside low unemployment indicates tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: Returns are positive under these conditions.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production growth in a recovery regime signals positive S&P 500 returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: Returns are negative during recovery with industrial growth.
